title: BatchTopK sparse autoencoder (real LM activations)
description: Replace the per-sample TopK activation with a batch-level one: keep the batch size times k largest activations across the whole batch. Inputs that contain more features can use more latents and simple inputs fewer, with the same average sparsity. Prediction: in a setting where the number of active features varies a lot (children only fire with parents), the dictionary recovers the planted features at least as well as a per-sample TopK SAE. Same idea and prediction as on the toy testbed, now on Pythia-70M activations with planted features, the scale these methods were designed for.
